0022600091.text: Both teams open their 2026-27 seasons when the Dallas Mavericks visit the Houston Rockets. The teams split their four 2025-26 meetings 2-2, most recently on January 31 in Houston, where Dallas lost 111-107. Houston's Steven Adams is day-to-day with rest and is a game-time decision, and ESPN's matchup predictor gives Dallas a 30% chance to win.
